messages:
alice: Canary rollout to shard-3 shows ~120 service accounts got `role:admin` after perm_v3 migration. Not expected.
ben: Any errors in the migration job? logs?
carol_m: I saw KMS unwrap errors earlier at ~2026-03-19T12:04:07Z, looks like a key rotation race. snippet: ```ERROR: failed to decrypt envelope: KMS InvalidCiphertext```
dave_ops: Quick query: `select count(*) from role_assignments where role='admin' and created_at > '2026-03-19' and principal_type='service_account';` -> 118 rows on shard-3.
infra-bot: canary metric: admin-grant-rate spike +0.8% on shard-3 (auto-alert suppressed). stack: perm_v3 migration -> seed_writer -> role_assignments.
deploy-bot: perm_v3 rollout paused on remaining shards at 2360012347.
sec_oncall: Immediate mitigation plan: 1) keep rollout paused 2) pause any role backfill jobs 3) run targeted rollback to revoke admin where created_by_migration='perm_v3' 4) re-enable audit capture for non-user principals.
sec_oncall: rollback snippet (run in migration maintenance window):
```
BEGIN;
UPDATE role_assignments SET role='developer' 
  WHERE principal_type='service_account' 
    AND created_by_migration='perm_v3' 
    AND role='admin'
    AND created_at >= '2026-03-19T12:00:00Z';
DELETE FROM role_seeds 
  WHERE source='perm_v3' 
    AND principal_type='service_account' 
    AND created_at >= '2026-03-19T12:00:00Z';
COMMIT;
```
audit-bot: FYI the audit pipeline filter `WHERE principal_type = 'user'` dropped service-account events between 12:03-12:15 UTC. We'll need to backfill from raw topic `audit-raw`.
ben: Root cause hypothesis: `permission_transform` uses a LEFT JOIN + COALESCE that resolves legacy_role -> 'admin' when KMS envelope fails and seed metadata is null. I'll open a tiny repro and PR to fix the join semantics + add a unit test.
alice: Good. We also need exact KMS rotation timestamps and which key version was used for the failing envelopes. Carol, can you collect KMS logs and the rotation event?
carol_m: On it. I already fetched KMS rotation markers from 12:02-12:05 UTC and a handful of failed decrypts. I'll push a sanitized bundle to the incident folder.
dave_ops: After rollback, I'll run `select count(*) from role_assignments where role='admin' and created_by_migration='perm_v3'` and share counts. Also will run a small smoke test: service-account token introspection + list-projects to ensure no elevated access persists.
sec_oncall: Marking this as P1 and tracking in the incident doc. Action owners: @ben fix transformation, @carol_m KMS evidence & audit backfill, @dave_ops rollback+verification. Keep replies short and post updates here. :rotating_light:
